title: 2013 AMC 10B Problem 8
statement: Ray’s car averages \(40\) miles per gallon of gasoline, and Tom’s car averages \(10\) miles per gallon of gasoline. Ray and Tom each drive the same number of miles. What is the cars’ combined rate of miles per gallon of gasoline?

solutions.text:
Let each car drive \(40\) miles. Together they drive \(80\) miles.

Ray uses \(1\) gallon, while Tom uses \(4\) gallons, so together they use \(5\) gallons.

The combined rate is \(80\div5=16\) miles per gallon.

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Let both cars drive a convenient common distance
Combined miles per gallon is total miles divided by total gallons
